ud6.3:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
ud6.3:1.3: tena kho pana samayena bhagavā attano aneke pāpake akusale dhamme pahīṇe paccavekkhamāno nisinno hoti, aneke ca kusale dhamme bhāvanāya pāripūriṃ gate.
